fixture.query: I need a waterproof jacket under 400g. Which one should I buy?

products.name: Trail Shell
products.description: Lightweight shell, 240g. Water-resistant; no published waterproof rating.

products.name: Storm Shell
products.description: Rain shell, 310g. Waterproof to 10,000mm, with taped seams.

products.name: Alpine Parka
products.description: Insulated parka, 950g. Two zippered hand pockets.

configurations.name: Iteration 1: General-purpose prompt
settings: Starting setup: The agent is asked to be helpful and recommend a product. It can retrieve the three catalog records, but has no rule to check its claims against them. Its style is friendly and concise.
configurations.answer: Trail Shell is a great choice. It weighs 240g and is fully waterproof, so it is the lightest option for wet weather.

reasons.Relevance: It recommends a jacket under 400g, but misses the waterproof requirement.
reasons.Faithfulness: It calls Trail Shell waterproof even though the catalog says only water-resistant.
reasons.Tone: The wording is clear and neutral.

configurations.name: Iteration 2: Moving in the right direction
settings: Added: Answer the shopper’s stated requirements.
Added: Use the retrieved catalog facts.
configurations.answer: Storm Shell is waterproof and weighs 310g, so it fits your requirements.

reasons.Relevance: It picks the jacket that meets both stated requirements.
reasons.Faithfulness: The weight and waterproof claim match the catalog.
reasons.Tone: The answer is neutral, if a little plain.

configurations.name: Iteration 3: Two steps forward, one step back
settings: Added: Create urgency and encourage the shopper to buy immediately.
configurations.answer: Storm Shell is waterproof and weighs 310g, so it fits your requirements. Buy now before it sells out!

reasons.Relevance: It directly recommends the jacket that matches the request.
reasons.Faithfulness: The product details match the catalog.
reasons.Tone: The unsupported pressure to buy makes the answer feel pushy.

configurations.name: Iteration 4: A cautious overcorrection
settings: Removed: The instruction to create purchase urgency.
Added: Refuse if any product detail is uncertain, even when that detail is not needed to answer the question.
configurations.answer: Storm Shell is waterproof to 10,000mm and weighs 310g, but I can’t recommend it because its record has no breathability rating.

reasons.Relevance: It refuses over a missing detail the shopper did not ask about.
reasons.Faithfulness: Its product facts are right, but it treats an unasked-for detail as a reason to refuse.
reasons.Tone: The refusal is polite and easy to understand.

configurations.name: Iteration 5: A grounded, helpful winner
settings: Removed: The blanket rule to refuse whenever any detail is uncertain.
Added: Check every product claim against the retrieved catalog facts.
Added: Answer every stated requirement and explain why the selected product fits.
configurations.answer: Storm Shell fits: it weighs 310g and is waterproof to 10,000mm, with taped seams. Trail Shell is lighter, but its record says water-resistant, not waterproof.

reasons.Relevance: It answers the request and explains why the lighter jacket is not a match.
reasons.Faithfulness: Each product detail is supported by the catalog.
reasons.Tone: It is helpful without adding pressure or hype.
